    // True when an undirected edge borders only one triangle: its naming corner
    // has no twin.
    IsBoundaryEdge(self: TriangleMeshTopology, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Boolean
        => self.CornerTwins[self.EdgeCorners[edge.Value].Value].IsNone;

    // The vertex of the triangle at an edge's naming corner that does not lie on
    // the edge: the apex the edge sees on that side.
    EdgeApex(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): VertexIndex
        => self.CornerVertex(PreviousCorner(topology.EdgeCorners[edge.Value]));

    // The apex on the far side of an edge; the "none" index on a boundary edge.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Typed indices (-1 means "none").
    EdgeFarApex(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): VertexIndex
    {
        var twin = topology.CornerTwins[topology.EdgeCorners[edge.Value].Value];
        return twin.IsNone ? VertexIndex(-1) : self.CornerVertex(PreviousCorner(twin));
    }

    // The straight-line length of an undirected edge.
    EdgeLength(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Number
    {
        var pair = topology.UndirectedEdges[edge.Value];
        return self.Positions[pair.A.Value].Distance(self.Positions[pair.B.Value]);
    }

    // The midpoint of an undirected edge.
    EdgeMidpoint(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Point3D
    {
        var pair = topology.UndirectedEdges[edge.Value];
        return self.Positions[pair.A.Value].Lerp(self.Positions[pair.B.Value], 0.5);
    }

    // A per-edge decision array that selects exactly one edge: the single-operator
    // form of every batched pass below.
    SingleEdgeMask(edgeCount: Integer, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Array<Boolean>
        => edgeCount.MapRange(e => e == edge.Value);

    // True for every vertex that lies on the surface boundary. Boundary vertices
    // are pinned by the smoothing passes and refused by the collapse passes, which
    // is what stops a remesh from eroding an open border.
    BoundaryVertexFlags(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology): Array<Boolean>
        => self.Positions.Count.MapRange(v =>
            topology.UndirectedEdges.Count.MapRange(e => e).Reduce(false, (found, e) =>
                found.Or(topology.IsBoundaryEdge(UndirectedEdgeIndex(e))
                    .And(PairTouches(topology.UndirectedEdges[e], v)))));

    // The valence of every vertex: how many undirected edges meet at it.
    VertexValences(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology): Array<Integer>
        => self.Positions.Count.MapRange(v => topology.UndirectedEdges.Count
            .MapRange(e => PairTouches(topology.UndirectedEdges[e], v) ? 1 : 0)
            .Reduce(0, (acc, hit) => acc + hit));

    // The neighbours of every vertex, one row per vertex, in edge order.
    VertexNeighborTable(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology): Array<Array<VertexIndex>>
        => self.Positions.Count.MapRange(v => topology.UndirectedEdges.Count
            .MapRange(e => e)
            .Reduce(Repeat(0, VertexIndex(0)), (acc, e) =>
                PairTouches(topology.UndirectedEdges[e], v)
                    ? acc.Append(PairOtherEnd(topology.UndirectedEdges[e], v))
                    : acc));

    //==
    // # Vertex remaps
    //
    // The single intermediate every vertex-REMOVING operation goes through.
    // Welding, edge collapse and quadric decimation each decide which vertices
    // become one and where the survivor lands; from there they are the same
    // computation, and it lives here.

    // The remap that keeps every vertex that is its own representative, numbering
    // the survivors in ascending order, and sends every other vertex to its
    // representative's new number. `placement` supplies each surviving vertex's
    // position, taking its OLD number. Precondition: `representatives` is
    // idempotent — the representative of a representative is itself.
    CompactMerge(representatives: Array<VertexIndex>, placement: Function1<Integer, Point3D>): VertexRemap
    {
        var n = representatives.Count;
        var survives = n.MapRange(i => representatives[i].Value == i);
        var rank = n.MapRange(i =>
            i.MapRange(d => survives[d] ? 1 : 0).Reduce(0, (acc, hit) => acc + hit));
        var targets = n.MapRange(i => VertexIndex(rank[representatives[i].Value]));
        var kept = n.MapRange(i => i).Reduce(Repeat(0, Point3D.Origin),
            (acc, i) => survives[i] ? acc.Append(placement(i)) : acc);
        return (targets, kept);
    }

    // One pointer-jumping pass: every vertex takes its representative's
    // representative (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pointer_jumping).
    JumpedRepresentatives(representatives: Array<VertexIndex>): Array<VertexIndex>
        => representatives.Map(v => representatives[v.Value]);

    // Representative chains resolved to their fixed points, which is what makes an
    // arbitrary "vertex i merges into vertex j" table usable by `CompactMerge`.
    // Each pass at least halves the longest remaining chain, so thirty-two passes
    // settle any chain a four-billion-vertex mesh could hold.
    ResolvedRepresentatives(representatives: Array<VertexIndex>): Array<VertexIndex>
        => Repeat(32, 0).Reduce(representatives, (reps, pass) => JumpedRepresentatives(reps));

    // A face's corners carried through a remap. A corner whose vertex was dropped
    // becomes the "none" index, which `IsDegenerateFace` then rejects.
    RemappedFace(remap: VertexRemap, face: TriangleFace): TriangleFace
        => (remap.Targets[face.A.Value],
            remap.Targets[face.B.Value],
            remap.Targets[face.C.Value]);

    // True when a face no longer names three distinct present vertices, which is
    // exactly the face a merge has collapsed to a segment or a point.
    IsDegenerateFace(face: TriangleFace): Boolean
        => face.A.IsNone
            .Or(face.B.IsNone)
            .Or(face.C.IsNone)
            .Or(face.A.Value == face.B.Value)
            .Or(face.B.Value == face.C.Value)
            .Or(face.C.Value == face.A.Value);

    // The remapped face, or no face at all where the merge degenerated it. The
    // empty / singleton pair is how a filter is written over `FlatMap`.
    SurvivingFaces(remap: VertexRemap, face: TriangleFace): Array<TriangleFace>
    {
        var moved = RemappedFace(remap, face);
        return IsDegenerateFace(moved) ? Repeat(0, moved) : [moved];
    }

    // The mesh rebuilt through a remap: the remap's positions, and the face table
    // rewritten with every degenerate face dropped.
    ApplyRemap(self: TriangleMesh3D, remap: VertexRemap): TriangleMesh3D
        => (remap.RemappedPositions, self.Faces.FlatMap(f => SurvivingFaces(remap, f)));

    //==
    // # Welding
    //
    // Turning triangle soup into a mesh with shared vertices: the pass marching
    // cubes, CSG and STL import all want and nothing in the tree provided.
    // Two vertices merge when they are within `tolerance` of each other; the
    // survivor is the lowest-numbered member of the group and keeps its own
    // position, so welding never moves geometry.
    //
    // Cost: quadratic in the vertex count.

    // The lowest-numbered vertex within `tolerance` of vertex i. Scans downwards
    // so the last match kept is the smallest, the same trick
    // `FirstCornerOfVertex` (`meshes-polygon.library.plato`) uses.
    WeldRepresentative(positions: Array<Point3D>, i: Integer, tolerance: Number): VertexIndex
        => VertexIndex((i + 1).MapRange(j => i - j)
            .Reduce(i, (found, j) => positions[j].Distance(positions[i]) <= tolerance ? j : found));

    // The remap that merges every group of vertices within `tolerance`. The raw
    // representatives can chain (a is within tolerance of b, b of c, but not a of
    // c), so they are resolved to fixed points before compaction.
    WeldRemap(positions: Array<Point3D>, tolerance: Number): VertexRemap
    {
        var raw = positions.Count.MapRange(i => WeldRepresentative(positions, i, tolerance));
        return CompactMerge(ResolvedRepresentatives(raw), i => positions[i]);
    }

    // The mesh with coincident vertices merged and the faces that became
    // degenerate dropped.
    Welded(self: TriangleMesh3D, tolerance: Number): TriangleMesh3D
        => self.ApplyRemap(WeldRemap(self.Positions, tolerance));
